subject: Sweetness Is a Signal, Not a Switch: Why Cutting Sweet Foods Won't Rewire Your Taste
script: From Agewell Brief: Sweetness Is a Signal, Not a Switch: Why Cutting Sweet Foods Won't Rewire Your Taste. A six-month randomized trial finds that altering dietary sweetness doesn't change cravings, weight, or metabolic markers. The real target may be sugar and energy density, not taste. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
